commitments.detail: Purge the room for 30 minutes to clear any remaining fumes.
Continuous monitoring of hydrogen levels until deemed safe by environmental compliance.
Document the incident and follow up as per standard procedure.
Ensure sprinkler valve is re-opened and tested before re-entry.
Purge the room for at least 30 minutes before re-entry.
Implement continuous hydrogen monitoring during re-entry and production.
Document the incident and any findings in the environmental incident record.

Document the incident and follow-up actions in the environmental compliance log.
